channel.title: Nutshell incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Nutshell's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Slowdown & delays for some customers [resolved]
item.description: We have addressed the database issue which caused some slowdowns for our customers. We are continuing to expand our infrastructure fleet for a more reliable and speedy Nutshell experience!

item.title: Database upgrade [resolved]
item.description: Our upgrade completed successfully, with no customer impact.

item.title: Reports of Nutshell not loading for several customers [resolved]
Nutshell outage [resolved]
item.description: Nutshell has been performing at optimal levels for several hours. We continue to monitor for any issues that might result from our infrastructure provider. Our team will perform a retrospective to identify ways to mitigate future issues and learn from this experience. No data was lost during this event.

item.title: Temporary Nutshell access issues [resolved]
item.description: On August 21, from approximately 8:00 AM to 8:35 AM Eastern Daylight Time, some Nutshell customers experienced difficulty logging in or accessing their Nutshell account. We identified an overloaded authentication service, due to an upcoming software upgrade. We've resolved the configuration issue. Sorry for the trouble!
